theme: A quiet Wednesday winding down; tomorrow afternoon the train carries you south to DC.
greeting: The day's been open, Dan, with the girls at Jen's — one gentle midday block and otherwise yours. Tomorrow the 3:16 out of New York takes you down to Washington, and your updated Amtrak ticket is already in the inbox.

needsAttention.title: Interview update asks for your work authorization
needsAttention.detail: An 'Interview Update' for a Senior Vice President of Global Public Policy role, sent via sourcehire.app, asks you to confirm your work authorization to "keep your application moving" — worth confirming the sender and link are legitimate before you respond.

flagged.title: Possible phishing — verify before acting
flagged.detail: jobs@sourcehire.app asks you to confirm visa/work authorization for a 'Confidential' Senior VP Global Public Policy role (REQ64085). Unnamed employer, odd domain, sent twice — likely a scam. Don't confirm anything.
